description: This file defines the Create feature for articles, including command and handler classes that process article creation requests, validate input, manage related tags, and persist new articles in the database.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Container class encapsulating all nested classes related to creating an article, including data, validators, command, and handler.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: DTO for passing article information such as title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validates that the article data fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Command record representing a request to create an article, carrying the article data.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command object, especially ensuring the included article data is valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles processing the create article command, including fetching the author, managing tags, creating the article entity, and saving all to the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the create article command, including setting up related data and returning the created article envelope.
